title: Dashboard
subtitle: Server runtime overview.
no_servers_hint: Create a server, claim an existing server, or request allocation from an administrator.
account_linked_desc: The Web account is linked to a Minecraft profile. Authorized claiming and startup operations are available.
account_unlinked_desc: Link a Minecraft profile from Account before claiming or operating servers.
link_status_checking: Checking whether a game character is linked…
no_servers_monitor: No active instances in the cluster
images_security_note: . Image availability is controlled by the whitelist. Build scan results are available in build records.
quick_start_step1: After a server is claimed, the system adds the corresponding Minecraft UUID to its access whitelist.
quick_start_step2: When a server reaches its configured idle duration, it stops automatically and saves the world to release runtime resources.
quick_start_step3: The Velocity gateway provides game access through each server’s dedicated subdomain.
welcome_desc: Use My Servers to view, claim, and manage authorized servers, including startup, shutdown, and log inspection.
fleet_flat_webgl: WebGL is unavailable. The fleet is displayed in a two-dimensional view.
fleet_flat_error: The 3D view failed to load. The fleet is displayed in a two-dimensional view.
staff_unlinked_desc: No Minecraft profile is linked. Panel administration is available. Select an authentication source and link a profile from Account before joining the game.
